title: Equivalence of quantum resources under ergodic dynamics
summary: Quantum resource theories characterize distinct forms of nonclassicality in many-body quantum states, raising the question of whether these resources evolve independently under generic ergodic dynamics. Considering diagnostics quadratic in the state, we show that the dynamics of different resource measures become mutually interdependent and are governed by a few common degrees of freedom.
